note: The lapse cost of the replenishment decision (docs/use-cases.md section 7a, U8). Every value is a stylised choice of the example, not read from a pharmacy. The planner is GIVEN the coupling (ppm and window), as it is given the outreach uplifts.

cost.note: the cost of one lapse, in the units of penalty_per_unit_short: a lapse ends a patient's series (10.7 refills on average), taken as one unit each at the shortage penalty of 10

ppm.note: the twin's lapse_stockout_ppm, given to the planner

window_weeks.note: the twin's stockout_window_weeks, given to the planner

history_weeks.note: the weeks of refill events, up to the decision week, from which the events a week of an item are counted

z_cap.note: the highest quantile the target may be raised to
